ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at less than 5% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters localized at the distal tips (left and right). Singular white pixel clusters and small circular marks are scattered across the mid-section and trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow acute angle and significant depth relative to the overall fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) across the entire length of the trailing edge on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, showing a moderately steep upward trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized circular high-contrast rings (white borders) detected on the right lobe; dense clusters of white pixels concentrated at the extreme distal points of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned horizontal and diagonal white linear disruptions visible on the medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and potential barnacle colonization visible as high-contrast clusters at the tips and scattered circular lesions across the dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits an exceptionally jagged, irregular topography with several deep secondary notches or indentations.
